fields.label: Enable Intercity Delivery
fields.description: Master switch for intercity fulfilment via third-party logistics providers. Leave off until a provider contract is signed and credentials are configured.

fields.label: Pickup Location Grace Period (Hours)
fields.description: Delay before an unused provider-side pickup location (warehouse) is deleted after its last in-flight shipment closes.

fields.label: ShipRazor API Key
fields.description: Server-side only. Never exposed to client apps (Merchant Agreement clause 1.2).

fields.label: ShipRazor Webhook Secret
fields.description: Shared secret used to authenticate inbound status webhooks.
